25 November 2026 · Travel Bug #3 · TBBD913

Next stop – Norfolk Island!

A new island adventure awaits one of our six original little travellers. Two new discovery logs have brought a promise of travel and a little laughter to the Kevin Bacon Challenge.

Liz and Bruce · Discovered it

An island adventure awaits

“This one is coming to Norfolk Island with us. Thanks”

Thank you, Liz and Bruce, for including our little traveller in your plans! We look forward to hearing about the places, people and connections it discovers along the way.

Norfolk Island is the intended next destination; arrival has not yet been confirmed.

TeamJLBL · Discovered it

A delicious Kevin Bacon connection

“The only link to Keven Bacon I have is that I love to eat bacon. Seen at our event.”

Sometimes the connections that bring us together are simply a shared laugh. Thank you for discovering our little traveller and being part of the adventure!

🇬🇧 England · Travel photographs

Kevin explores northern England

One of the Kevin Bacon Challenge travellers has been photographed on an adventure through the countryside and historic places of northern England. Here's a little scrapbook of stone walls, local landmarks and a few geocaching treasures along the way.

🇬🇧 15 November 2026 · Kirkby Lonsdale, Cumbria

Hillgorilla at Kirkby Lonsdale — a local geocaching gathering

The shared Geocaching screenshot shows the event “Hillgorilla at Kirkby Lonsdale. NWCMM.” (GC BZ5FW ), hosted by Hillgorilla from 12:00–12:30 pm . It is another lovely connection with the area our little traveller has explored. The event listing does not confirm whether our trackable attended.

The journey continues

Friends and fellow travellers

🇳🇱 Netherlands · 7 November 2026

Ingrid’s parcel arrives

Ingrid, also known as Secretbox on Geocaching, offered to help the challenge from the Netherlands. A special parcel departed Australia on 22 October , and she confirmed receiving it on 7 November .

“I picked up the parcel and it is amazing. Love what you did.”

She enjoys exploring by bicycle, and shared plans to go geocaching with family in South Carolina around Christmas.

The parcel arrived; a public geocache drop by Ingrid has not yet been confirmed.

🇩🇪 German visitors in Queensland · 11 November 2026

A surprise at Stormwater Lookout!

German travellers visiting Hervey Bay found Michelle's Stormwater Lookout! geocache. Geocacher gerd9999 shared a photograph of the trackable and wrote:

“Travel Bug OZQCEZ aus der Dose entnommen”

That means “Travel Bug OZQCEZ taken out of the cache.” Michelle messaged the visitors to ask whether they might help it continue its adventure.

The cache log reports a pickup, but onward travel to Germany has not been confirmed.

🇺🇸 A possible next chapter · Christmas 2026

Perhaps South Carolina?

Ingrid hopes to visit family in South Carolina over Christmas and go geocaching during her visit. She and Michelle discussed whether the travel bug should start in the Netherlands or go with her to America.

A possible plan, not a completed movement.
